title: Design System: Hu Jiao Personal Website

display.purpose: Modest home name and independent page headings; Chinese resets tracking to zero.

body.purpose: Self-hosted Manrope; Chinese prioritizes native PingFang SC and Microsoft YaHei with 1.9 line height.

motion.name: page-arrival
motion.purpose: Single page entrance, opacity 0.7 to 1 and translateY 8px to 0.

components.name: Primary Email Action
components.description: Home contact action with restrained upward hover.
components.html: Get in touch

components.name: Header Email
components.description: Compact outlined email action, hidden on narrow mobile headers.

components.name: Page Navigation
components.html: HomeExperienceProjectsPhotography
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:26px;font:16px/1.75 Manrope,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#302d29)}.ds-nav a{position:relative;display:block;padding:10px 0;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.ds-nav a::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;height:2px;background:var(--accent,#a64f38);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--accent,#a64f38)}.ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a[aria-current]::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a64f38);outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 24px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a::after{transition:none}}

components.name: Language Controls
components.description: Plain bilingual buttons with an underlined selected language.

components.name: Photography Empty State
components.description: Honest text when no supplied photograph has loaded; no placeholder image or preview button.

narrative.overview: A restrained personal website that introduces Hu Jiao and makes room for work, independent projects, and photography. Near-white paper, warm charcoal type, and occasional terracotta actions keep the presentation approachable and clear.
keyCharacteristics: A modest name, personal subtitle, and readable biography lead Home.
Four native page links replace the former scrolling dossier.
Self-hosted Manrope pairs with native Chinese fonts.
Flat surfaces and hairline rules organize information.
Missing photographs produce a text empty state, without placeholder images.
Motion stays brief and respects reduced-motion preferences.
dos: Do preserve the approved home subtitle and bilingual biography.
Do maintain all four independent pages and native navigation.
Do use near-white paper, warm charcoal, and restrained terracotta.
Do keep English and Chinese typography equally readable.
Do use supplied facts and photographs only.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't restore cobalt, the old profile rail, or scrolling section navigation.
Don't add image placeholders, fabricated work, or invented metrics.
Don't introduce scroll snapping, large motion, shadows, or decorative cards.
